---
title: "QoL six-month landmark: descriptive summaries"
subtitle: "Observed, imputed and model-derived six-month state distributions"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
# rms must be attached: the adjusted model formula calls rcs(), which
# predict() re-evaluates on the new data.
library(rms)
library(rmsb)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

landmark_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "03-quality-of-life", "02-six-month-landmark", "results"
)
results_dir <- file.path(landmark_dir, "descriptive")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

m_main <- config$imputation$m_main
m_supporting <- config$imputation$m_supporting

prepared <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "03-quality-of-life", "results", "prepared.parquet")
)
completed_datasets <- map(seq_len(m_main), \(index) {
  readRDS(file.path(
    landmark_dir, "imputations", sprintf("completed-%02d.rds", index)
  ))
})

state_levels <- as.character(1:8)
display_levels <- c(state_levels, "Missing")
```

## Raw data

```{r}
#| label: raw-summaries
#| include: false

raw_summary <- prepared |>
  group_by(tx) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    deaths_by_day_182 = sum(event_death == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    baseline_qol_observed = sum(!is.na(baseline_q30)),
    baseline_qol_missing = sum(is.na(baseline_q30)),
    landmark_qol_observed = sum(!is.na(landmark_q30)),
    landmark_qol_missing = sum(is.na(landmark_q30)),
    composite_observed = sum(!is.na(y_landmark)),
    composite_missing = sum(is.na(y_landmark)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

raw_counts <- prepared |>
  mutate(
    state = if_else(is.na(y_landmark), "Missing", as.character(y_landmark)),
    state = factor(state, levels = display_levels)
  ) |>
  count(tx, state, .drop = FALSE, name = "n") |>
  group_by(tx) |>
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n),
    source = "Observed raw data"
  ) |>
  ungroup()

write_parquet(raw_summary, file.path(results_dir, "raw-summary.parquet"))
write_parquet(raw_counts, file.path(results_dir, "raw-state-counts.parquet"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-raw-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Availability of the raw QoL variables by randomized group"
#| echo: false

kable(raw_summary)
```

## Completed datasets

```{r}
#| label: imputed-proportions
#| include: false

imputed_probabilities <- completed_datasets |>
  imap(\(data, index) {
    data |>
      mutate(state = factor(y_landmark, levels = 1:8)) |>
      count(tx, state, .drop = FALSE, name = "n") |>
      group_by(tx) |>
      mutate(
        imputation = index,
        proportion = n / sum(n)
      ) |>
      ungroup() |>
      select(imputation, tx, state, proportion)
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

write_parquet(
  imputed_probabilities,
  file.path(results_dir, "imputed-state-probabilities.parquet")
)
```

## Model-standardized state probabilities

```{r}
#| label: model-probabilities
#| include: false

# Called once per model (adjusted and unadjusted).
model_state_summary <- function(model_name, m, seed_family, n_draws) {
  model_draws <- seq_len(m) |>
    map(\(index) {
      model <- readRDS(file.path(
        landmark_dir, model_name, "models", sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index)
      ))

      set.seed(seed_family + (index - 1) * 1000 + 700)
      selected <- sample.int(nrow(model$draws), n_draws, replace = FALSE)
      model$draws <- model$draws[selected, , drop = FALSE]

      map(0:1, \(treatment) {
        # Draws x participants x states; average over participants.
        probabilities <- predict(
          model,
          newdata = completed_datasets[[index]] |> mutate(tx = treatment),
          type = "fitted.ind",
          posterior.summary = "all"
        )
        standardized <- apply(probabilities, c(1, 3), mean)

        expand_grid(
          draw = seq_len(nrow(standardized)),
          state = state_levels
        ) |>
          mutate(
            imputation = index,
            tx = treatment,
            probability = as.vector(t(standardized))
          )
      }) |>
        list_rbind()
    }) |>
    list_rbind()

  model_draws |>
    group_by(tx, state) |>
    summarise(
      proportion = median(probability),
      q025 = quantile(probability, 0.025, names = FALSE),
      q975 = quantile(probability, 0.975, names = FALSE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(n = NA_integer_)
}

adjusted_summary <- model_state_summary(
  "adjusted",
  m = m_main,
  seed_family = config$seeds$qol,
  n_draws = config$posterior_draws$main
) |>
  mutate(source = "Median proportional-odds prediction")

unadjusted_summary <- model_state_summary(
  "unadjusted",
  m = m_supporting,
  seed_family = config$seeds$supporting,
  n_draws = config$posterior_draws$supporting
) |>
  mutate(source = "Median unadjusted proportional-odds prediction")

write_parquet(
  adjusted_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "adjusted-model-state-probabilities.parquet")
)
write_parquet(
  unadjusted_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "unadjusted-model-state-probabilities.parquet")
)
```

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: state-distribution-plots
#| include: false

# Called once per model (adjusted and unadjusted). States use the state
# colours; the "Missing" category of the raw data is drawn as NA in grey.
state_distribution_plot <- function(model_summary, m) {
  imputed_summary <- imputed_probabilities |>
    filter(imputation <= m) |>
    group_by(tx, state) |>
    summarise(proportion = mean(proportion), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(
      n = NA_integer_,
      source = "Mean across completed datasets"
    )

  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    raw_counts |> select(tx, state, n, proportion, source),
    imputed_summary |> select(tx, state, n, proportion, source),
    model_summary |> select(tx, state, n, proportion, source)
  ) |>
    mutate(
      state = factor(state, levels = state_levels),
      tx = group_factor(tx),
      source = fct_inorder(source)
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = tx, y = proportion, fill = state)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    facet_wrap(vars(source), nrow = 1L, labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 25)) +
    scale_fill_state(
      drop = FALSE,
      na.value = "grey75",
      labels = \(states) replace_na(states, "Missing")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Proportion",
      fill = "QoL/death state"
    ) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}

adjusted_plot <- state_distribution_plot(adjusted_summary, m = m_main)
unadjusted_plot <- state_distribution_plot(unadjusted_summary, m = m_supporting)

save_figure(
  adjusted_plot,
  file.path(results_dir, "adjusted-state-distributions.png")
)
save_figure(
  unadjusted_plot,
  file.path(results_dir, "unadjusted-state-distributions.png")
)
```
